title: llms-full.txt and one help article point crawlers at pages that bounce

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail: llms-full.txt links to member-only addresses that redirect a signed-out reader to sign in (/founder, /journal, /rewards, /upgrade, /on-air, /circles), so an answer engine following them lands on the sign-in page. content/help/spaces/network.md links to /networks, which redirects to /for/networks. Event pages link a Circle by its id (/discover/circles/<uuid>, a redirect to the named address), and /discover/spaces carries links to /support and /partners/<slug> that redirect to the home page. Wanted: public links only in the AI files, and links that point at the final address.

verify.evidence: Production crawl, 2026-11-19: each of the listed addresses answered 307 or 308 to an anonymous request; llms-full.txt (396 KB) contained all six member paths.
